g.text: Sequence Diagram - VIS07 Pan, Orbit, Dolly, Reset View and Per-Frame Limits
Listeners are on the canvas only: input over the VIS06 GUI, toolbar or menus
never moves the camera. Mouse events only change the OrbitControls state;
limits are applied and the view is rendered in the next frame (section 5).
accumulate pan on the floor plane (y = 0)
pan applied (and clamped) on the next frame
accumulate rotation around the current target
orbit applied on the next frame
wheel (DOLLY); preventDefault: page does not scroll
accumulate dolly towards / away from the target;
dolly applied on the next frame
initial view of the current layout,
Native controls.reset() is NOT used: it keeps the
damping momentum and the camera would keep drifting
move camera closer along the SAME direction
[target inside x in [-w/2, w/2], z in [-d/2, d/2]]
move camera by the same correction
target and camera on the boundary
updated view shown on the canvas
The pan limit does not depend on the OrbitControls "change" event, which is
not emitted for movements below its internal threshold: the clamp runs on
EVERY frame, before render. Discarding the momentum at the boundary makes a
reversed drag respond immediately. CameraController is the single writer of
the camera (BR 8); no allocation per frame. Speeds 0.5 / 0.8 / 0.6.
